title: Implement Trie (Prefix Tree)

content.problemStatement:
You're given a single space-delimited sequence of operations to run
against an initially empty trie (prefix tree). Each token has the form
"op:argument":

- `insert:word` - adds word to the trie
- `search:word` - checks whether word was previously inserted exactly
- `startsWith:prefix` - checks whether any inserted word starts with prefix

**Simulate the tokens in order on the trie, and return a list containing
the result of every "search" and "startsWith" operation (1 for true, 0
for false), in the order they occurred.**

"insert" tokens produce no output and should be skipped in the result
list.
constraints: word and prefix consist only of lowercase English letters
content.inputFormat: Single line: JSON array of all arguments, e.g. [arg1, arg2, ...]

sampleTestCases.input: ops = "insert:apple search:apple search:app startsWith:app insert:app search:app"
sampleTestCases.explanation: after inserting "apple": search:apple=1 (exact match), search:app=0 (not inserted as a full word yet), startsWith:app=1 (apple starts with app); after inserting "app": search:app=1

sampleTestCases.input: ops = "insert:cat insert:car insert:card search:cat search:ca startsWith:ca startsWith:cars"
sampleTestCases.explanation: "ca" was never inserted as a full word (search:ca=0), but cat/car/card all start with "ca" (startsWith:ca=1); no word starts with "cars"
the trie is empty, so nothing can be found
